_comment: T-818 — the static work ceiling, shared across tiers. `limits.maxStaticWork` is a decimal string because the default (10^26) exceeds both Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER and int. The one-literal program's graph work proof is 130 in both tiers: a ceiling equal to the proof is admitted and evaluates, one unit below it refuses at compile with rule.compile.work_exceeded and the proof/ceiling params as decimal strings.

cases._comment: T-1024: a single-key object inside a literal array is data, not an operator, so the work proof charges it as literal bytes on both tiers. [{"kk":"v"}] is 2 + (2 + (2 + 6*2 + 1 + (2 + 6*1))) = 27 bytes with no separator for one key (a two-character key, so 6*len and 6/len differ); a Compute evaluates twice, so the proof is 2 * (1 + 2 * 27) = 110 (the one-literal case above is 2 * (1 + 2 * 32) = 130).
cases.name: work/single-key-object-literal-is-charged-as-data
